```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Render with `Rscript report/scripts/render.R` after `Rscript R/run_all.R`.
# The report reads only data/output/ and data/input/external/: every estimate,
# p-value and count in the text is computed from those files by the scripts
# below, so it cannot drift from the pipeline. Method settings fixed by design
# (distance thresholds, permutation and bootstrap counts) are typed, and match
# R/00_setup.R and the stage scripts.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, dpi = 300)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(sf) })
for (f in c("helpers.R", "results_score.R", "results_q1.R", "results_q2.R", "results_q3.R")) {
  source(file.path("scripts", f), local = knitr::knit_global())
}
```
